description: This file contains the ClaimDao class, which is responsible for managing data access operations related to Claims within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim events, expenses, attachments, and requests, utilizing Doctrine ORM's query builder and repository pattern. The class also provides filtering, pagination, and validation functionalities specific to claim-related data entities.

classes.name: ClaimDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling CRUD operations and complex queries related to claim entities such as events, expenses, attachments, and requests within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Persists a ClaimEvent entity and returns it.

methods.name: getClaimEventList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ClaimEvent entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getClaimEventById
methods.description: Fetches a ClaimEvent entity by its ID if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingClaimEventIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing ClaimEvent entities from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteClaimEvents
methods.description: Marks specified ClaimEvent entities as deleted.

methods.name: getClaimEventCount
methods.description: Returns the count of ClaimEvent entities matching search filters.

methods.name: saveExpenseType

methods.name: saveClaimRequest
methods.description: Persists a ClaimRequest entity.

methods.name: getNextId
